meta.title: Consuming Darkness – 1
meta.description: Capturing, consuming, eradicating... the collapsed star shall be as a shroud upon the universe.

units.rawText: <size=40>GET YOUR ASS OUT HERE, DAMMIT!</size>
units.displayText: GET YOUR ASS OUT HERE, DAMMIT!

spans.text: GET YOUR ASS OUT HERE, DAMMIT!

units.rawText: (Fortunately, she's not familiar with the base... I can still stall her for a while longer.)
units.displayText: Fortunately, she's not familiar with the base... I can still stall her for a while longer.

spans.text: Fortunately, she's not familiar with the base... I can still stall her for a while longer.

units.rawText: (The Hellbore Cannon's finished cooling down and I've got enough operands for 5 full-power shots. All my left side weapons systems are disabled.)
units.displayText: The Hellbore Cannon's finished cooling down and I've got enough operands for 5 full-power shots. All my left side weapons systems are disabled.

spans.text: The Hellbore Cannon's finished cooling down and I've got enough operands for 5 full-power shots. All my left side weapons systems are disabled.

units.rawText: (My right side weapons need ammo, I have 600 shots for my handheld gun... Fortunately I've got enough propellant left.)
units.displayText: My right side weapons need ammo, I have 600 shots for my handheld gun... Fortunately I've got enough propellant left.

spans.text: My right side weapons need ammo, I have 600 shots for my handheld gun... Fortunately I've got enough propellant left.

units.rawText: Hsss—
units.displayText: Hsss—

spans.text: Hsss—

units.rawText: What the?!
units.displayText: What the?!

spans.text: What the?!

units.rawText: A sticky tentacle silently coils around her and Xinghuan frantically tries to adjust the facing of her maneuver thrusters. However, just as she manages to avoid it, a long blade stabs down from the ceiling of her cramped hiding place, penetrating the exo's armor and piercing Xinghuan's left shoulder, nailing her to the ground.
units.displayText: A sticky tentacle silently coils around her and Xinghuan frantically tries to adjust the facing of her maneuver thrusters. However, just as she manages to avoid it, a long blade stabs down from the ceiling of her cramped hiding place, penetrating the exo's armor and piercing Xinghuan's left shoulder, nailing her to the ground.

spans.text: A sticky tentacle silently coils around her and Xinghuan frantically tries to adjust the facing of her maneuver thrusters. However, just as she manages to avoid it, a long blade stabs down from the ceiling of her cramped hiding place, penetrating the exo's armor and piercing Xinghuan's left shoulder, nailing her to the ground.

units.rawText: Got you at last!
units.displayText: Got you at last!

spans.text: Got you at last!

units.rawText: In the next moment, the ceiling breaks open and Caina rushes up to Xinghuan, following up on her sword strike with a swipe of her sharp claws!
units.displayText: In the next moment, the ceiling breaks open and Caina rushes up to Xinghuan, following up on her sword strike with a swipe of her sharp claws!

spans.text: In the next moment, the ceiling breaks open and Caina rushes up to Xinghuan, following up on her sword strike with a swipe of her sharp claws!

units.rawText: <size=40>HELLBORE CANNON, FIRE!</size>
units.displayText: HELLBORE CANNON, FIRE!

spans.text: HELLBORE CANNON, FIRE!

units.rawText: This is her only chance, now that the longsword is trapped. The scorching beam of light shatters the darkness, and Xinghuan quickly draws away, heedless of her own wounds.
units.displayText: This is her only chance, now that the longsword is trapped. The scorching beam of light shatters the darkness, and Xinghuan quickly draws away, heedless of her own wounds.

spans.text: This is her only chance, now that the longsword is trapped. The scorching beam of light shatters the darkness, and Xinghuan quickly draws away, heedless of her own wounds.

units.rawText: Tsk, you're quick on your feet... But I won't let you get away.
units.displayText: Tsk, you're quick on your feet... But I won't let you get away.

spans.text: Tsk, you're quick on your feet... But I won't let you get away.

units.rawText: Countless purple veins snake out from around the place where the sword is stuck in the ground. The Entropy virus spreads from the network of veins, instantly covering the entire base like a densely-woven purple net.
units.displayText: Countless purple veins snake out from around the place where the sword is stuck in the ground. The Entropy virus spreads from the network of veins, instantly covering the entire base like a densely-woven purple net.

spans.text: Countless purple veins snake out from around the place where the sword is stuck in the ground. The Entropy virus spreads from the network of veins, instantly covering the entire base like a densely-woven purple net.

units.rawText: Before long, entropic creatures take form and rise from the thick liquid Entropy, and they begin mobbing Xinghuan.
units.displayText: Before long, entropic creatures take form and rise from the thick liquid Entropy, and they begin mobbing Xinghuan.

spans.text: Before long, entropic creatures take form and rise from the thick liquid Entropy, and they begin mobbing Xinghuan.

units.rawText: There's nowhere for you to run, filthy vermin!
units.displayText: There's nowhere for you to run, filthy vermin!

spans.text: There's nowhere for you to run, filthy vermin!

units.rawText: Don't look down on a taikonaut's piloting skills!
units.displayText: Don't look down on a taikonaut's piloting skills!

spans.text: Don't look down on a taikonaut's piloting skills!

units.rawText: The exo-armor's jets fire downward and Xinghuan leaps up. The rifle she's holding spits tongues of fire, perforating the Low-Order Entropics trying to intercept her.
units.displayText: The exo-armor's jets fire downward and Xinghuan leaps up. The rifle she's holding spits tongues of fire, perforating the Low-Order Entropics trying to intercept her.

spans.text: The exo-armor's jets fire downward and Xinghuan leaps up. The rifle she's holding spits tongues of fire, perforating the Low-Order Entropics trying to intercept her.

units.rawText: Stop me if you can!
units.displayText: Stop me if you can!

spans.text: Stop me if you can!

units.rawText: Get her!
units.displayText: Get her!

spans.text: Get her!

units.rawText: A seething tide of entropic creatures hurls itself at Xinghuan. Xinghuan briefly glances at the progress bar on the terminal, then grits her teeth and maxes out her exo's throttle.
units.displayText: A seething tide of entropic creatures hurls itself at Xinghuan. Xinghuan briefly glances at the progress bar on the terminal, then grits her teeth and maxes out her exo's throttle.

spans.text: A seething tide of entropic creatures hurls itself at Xinghuan. Xinghuan briefly glances at the progress bar on the terminal, then grits her teeth and maxes out her exo's throttle.

units.rawText: (Pants) I need... to hold on...
units.displayText: (Pants) I need... to hold on...

spans.text: (Pants) I need... to hold on...

units.rawText: <size=60>Return in triumph, glory to Jiutian. Return in triumph, glory to Jiutian...!</size>
units.displayText: Return in triumph, glory to Jiutian. Return in triumph, glory to Jiutian...!

spans.text: Return in triumph, glory to Jiutian. Return in triumph, glory to Jiutian...!

units.rawText: Caina's angry shouts echo through the inside of the base. Xinghuan takes cover among a nest of pipes, turning her system output to its lowest setting as she focuses on keep track of Caina's movements.
units.displayText: Caina's angry shouts echo through the inside of the base. Xinghuan takes cover among a nest of pipes, turning her system output to its lowest setting as she focuses on keep track of Caina's movements.

spans.text: Caina's angry shouts echo through the inside of the base. Xinghuan takes cover among a nest of pipes, turning her system output to its lowest setting as she focuses on keep track of Caina's movements.

units.rawText: <size=40>Ugh...!</size>
units.displayText: Ugh...!

spans.text: Ugh...!

units.rawText: Her arm rips off savagely at the joint, and Xinghuan rolls aside before getting to her feet.
units.displayText: Her arm rips off savagely at the joint, and Xinghuan rolls aside before getting to her feet.

spans.text: Her arm rips off savagely at the joint, and Xinghuan rolls aside before getting to her feet.

units.rawText: Ahahahaha! I can't believe you tore off your own arm to escape! How disgusting!
units.displayText: Ahahahaha! I can't believe you tore off your own arm to escape! How disgusting!

spans.text: Ahahahaha! I can't believe you tore off your own arm to escape! How disgusting!
